name: Lausanne ML PhD approaching industry transition

context.seniority: Final-year PhD, industry newcomer with research experience
context.geography: Lausanne; open to European research hubs
constraints: Research contribution matters more than title alone
Avoid another PhD or unintended academic postdoc
Needs to understand applied versus research-scientist scope
context.company_awareness: Knows several major labs but little about research teams in less familiar product and industrial companies.

trigger: An adviser asks about plans after the thesis defense; job searches produce a confusing mixture of PhDs, postdocs, senior scientists and production engineering.

searches_run.query: machine learning research scientist PhD graduate jobs Europe
searches_run.observation: Retrieved a direct Citadel Securities PhD graduate role, ELLIS opportunities and mixed academic job sites. The employer page asks for an estimated graduation date and lists Dublin, London and Zurich; it also uses continuing-interest language rather than guaranteeing an immediate vacancy.

searches_run.query: emploi docteur machine learning industrie research scientist applied scientist différence
searches_run.observation: Retrieval surfaced English comparisons and a computing research association career guide despite the partly French query. This shows available title-comparison content, not evidence that French demand is large or underserved.

sources.title: Machine Learning Researcher – PhD Graduate Europe | Citadel Securities
sources.supports: Direct inspection confirms PhD-targeted title, multiple offices, anticipated graduation-date field, research/programming requirements and continuing-interest language.

sources.title: Jobs in the ELLIS Network
sources.supports: Retrieved listing mixes PhD and research scientist opportunities; relevant alternative needing role-type discrimination.

sources.title: From Faculty Researcher to Industry Research Scientist | Computing Research Association
sources.supports: Retrieved career-resource description frames industry research across several fields beyond AI; no detailed advice adopted without inspection.

sources.title: Data Scientist vs. Research Scientist vs. Applied Scientist | Indeed
sources.supports: Retrieval includes a title-comparison article, establishing an informational alternative rather than universal employer definitions.

best_entry_page.primary_query: machine learning research scientist PhD graduate jobs Europe
best_entry_page.promise: Map common industry research titles to posting responsibilities, then find covered European employers with relevant research openings.
best_entry_page.cta: Explore companies and save several research-title searches with European locations.
proof_needed: Source-backed examples of research, applied-science and engineering responsibilities
Filters that avoid academic PhD openings without discarding new doctoral graduates
Actual lab coverage and research-area relevance
Distinguish an open requisition from a talent-pool page
State that graduation flexibility needs employer confirmation

conversion_objections: Graduate filters may mean undergraduate schemes.
Seniority may mistake years researching for years in industry.
A broad ML alert produces irrelevant specialisms.
Can I start after my defense, or is this immediate hiring?
Will I find labs beyond the brands I already follow?

avoid_targeting.reason: No hiring guarantee or qualification matching is demonstrated.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
